source_note: The owner's prompt system, used with Stitch and Nano Banana 2.1. Models and arcs are word for word apart from typos. source_template is kept for reference; template is the version adapted for real products.
source_template:
[IMAGE FORMAT & COMPOSITION]
A 2x2 grid composite fashion photoshoot featuring 4 distinct sequential shots of the same model in a professional studio setting with a clean, seamless warm beige backdrop.

[MODEL SPECIFICATIONS]
[SELECT MODEL PROFILE: e.g., A Ghanaian woman named Akosua featuring a soft rounded jawline, dimpled cheeks, large expressive eyes, rich golden-chestnut brown skin, a curvy 5'6" hourglass build with full bust, and a sleek chin-length blunt bob with a sharp center part.]

[WARDROBE]
She is wearing a black sleeveless top with a scalloped neckline tucked into a vibrant, multi-tiered ruffled mini skirt made of traditional West African batik fabric (alternating bands of orange, olive green, and purple patterns).

[LIGHTING & SET]
Softbox studio lighting creating clean, wrap-around illumination with soft shadows. Minimal props: a small woven Bolgatanga straw basket placed near her feet in background shots.

[DIRECTORIAL NARRATIVE ARC: 4-Beat Progression]
- Top-Left Frame (Shot 1 - Beat 1: Vulnerability / Hesitation):
  Model seated on a wooden stool in a tight, protective posture. Round shoulders, slight forward spine curve, head tilted down with eyes downcast toward her hands clasped softly in her lap. Slightly elevated camera angle looking down.

- Top-Right Frame (Shot 2 - Beat 2: Subtle Curiosity):
  Model standing straight, weight shifted onto her back hip. One hand placed lightly on her hip, shoulder slightly dropped. Spine neutral, head lifted with a gentle, curious micro-smile, looking directly into the lens at eye level.

- Bottom-Left Frame (Shot 3 - Beat 3: Emerging Engagement):
  Model standing tall, centered in the frame. Shoulders open and squared, arms resting loosely at her sides. Strong, direct eye contact with a calm, neutral facial expression and a confident, upright posture.

- Bottom-Right Frame (Shot 4 - Beat 4: Complete Confidence & Energy):
  Model standing in a dynamic, expansive stance. Feet shoulder-width apart, both hands planted firmly on her hips. Chest open, chin slightly lifted, radiating a joyful, toothy smile directly to the camera. Wide camera perspective capturing studio lighting stands at the frame edges.

[STYLE & RENDERING]
Consistent lighting, identical subject identity, photorealistic skin texture, sharp focus on fabric folds and vibrant batik skirt patterns, shot on 85mm portrait lens aesthetic.

template.lighting_set: Softbox studio lighting creating clean, wrap-around illumination with soft shadows. Minimal props: a small woven Bolgatanga straw basket placed near her feet in background shots.
template.style: Consistent lighting, identical subject identity, photorealistic skin texture, sharp focus on the garment's fabric folds and print, shot on 85mm portrait lens aesthetic.

models.name: Abena
models.label: Slender & Angular
models.facial_features: High chiseled cheekbones, defined jawline, deep-set almond eyes, natural full lips.
models.skin: Deep ebony skin tone with a smooth, radiant satin finish.
models.build: Tall, lean 5'10" runner's build with a slender frame and small chest.
models.hair: Short, natural afro tapered neatly at the sides, subtle beauty mark above the left lip.

models.name: Akosua
models.label: Curvy & Soft
models.facial_features: Soft rounded jawline, dimpled cheeks, large expressive dark brown eyes, button nose.
models.skin: Rich golden-chestnut brown skin tone with a warm undertone and natural freckles across the nose bridge.
models.build: Curvy 5'6" hourglass build with full bust, soft waistline, and wide hips.
models.hair: Sleek chin-length blunt bob with a sharp center part.

models.name: Yaa
models.label: Athletic & Grounded
models.facial_features: Strong square jaw, prominent brow bone, intense piercing gaze, wide smile with a slight gap-tooth (diastema).
models.skin: Deep warm chocolate brown skin tone with a dewy, luminous finish.
models.build: Athletic 5'8" toned physique with broad shoulders, medium chest, and strong legs.
models.hair: Neat, shoulder-length knotless box braids tied partially back.

models.name: Efua
models.label: Petite & Delicate
models.facial_features: Heart-shaped face, delicate features, soft arched eyebrows, subtle upturned eyes.

models.hair: Intricate cornrow braid pattern pulled into a low sleek bun.

arcs.title: Hesitation to Authority
shots: Seated or standing closed; round shoulders, downcast eyes, hands clasped low over torso.
Weight shifted onto one leg, one hand resting on hip, head lifted with a subtle, inquiring gaze.
Feet shoulder-width apart, spine elongated, hands resting loosely at sides, direct neutral eye contact.
Both hands planted firmly on hips, chest open, shoulders squared, chin elevated, commanding smile.

arcs.title: Innocence to Dominance
shots: Soft focus gaze, head tilted sideways, relaxed jaw, hands gently touching collarbone.
Head straightens, chin tucks slightly, posture becomes erect, hands drop to sides.
Step forward toward camera, shoulders back, stern unblinking gaze into the lens.
Leaning torso slightly forward, arms crossed firmly over chest, intense piercing stare looking slightly down into the lens.

arcs.title: Submission to Defiance
shots: Head bowed low, eyes closed, shoulders collapsed inward as if burdened.
Head raises slowly, eyes open looking off-camera, jaw clenched with emerging resolve.
Body rotates to face the lens square-on, spine straightened, hands clenched into loose fists at sides.
Step forward, chin tilted high, fearless direct gaze, wide stable stance, uncompromising posture.

arcs.title: Overwhelmed to Composed
shots: Hands touching face/temples, tense neck muscles, wide anxious eyes looking off-frame.
Hands drop from face to rest on chest, eyes closed taking a deep stabilizing breath.
Eyes open, posture realigns vertically, shoulders relax down and back away from ears.
Smooth confident posture, subtle knowing smile, arms folded elegantly, tranquil authority.

arcs.title: Corporate Rigid to Uninhibited CEO
shots: Ultra-stiff symmetrical posture, locked elbows, rigid neck, forced tight smile.
One arm relaxes, head tilts, posture softens into a natural asymmetrical stance.
Weight resting comfortably on back hip, warm candid laugh, hand reaching toward frame edge.
Expansive relaxed stance, wide open arms, radiant authentic smile, effortless leadership posture.

arcs.title: Concealed to Revealed
shots: Model turned 90° away from lens, hiding face behind shoulder/hair, arms shielding chest.
Body rotates 45°, peering over shoulder toward camera with cautious curiosity.
Body faces full-frontal, hands lowering to waistline, direct open eye contact.
Broad open stance, head back, joyous open-mouthed expression, completely unshielded presence.

arcs.title: Amateur to Master
shots: Fumbling hands, hesitant stance, unsure eyes checking camera angle.
Hands settle at waist, posture grounds itself, gaze sharpens with focus.
Precise geometric posing, sharp angles in arms, poised head alignment.
Relaxed mastery—one hand in pocket/on hip, casual lean, calm unshakeable presence.

arcs.title: Shadow to Spotlight
shots: Shrinking away from key light, hunched frame, face partially in shadow.
Leaning toward light source, eyes catching key catchlight, posture uncurling.
Step directly into center light, chest lifted, shoulders back.
Strikes a high-fashion editorial power pose, absorbing full studio illumination.

arcs.title: Distance to Intimacy
shots: Torso angled away, chin down, barrier gesture (crossed arms), distant aloof gaze.
Torso turns toward lens, arms uncross, gaze shifts directly to camera.
Model leans upper body forward toward lens, hands resting gently on knees/thighs.
Tight emotional proximity—soft facial expression, exposed neck, warm inviting smile as if sharing a secret.

arcs.title: Control to Chaos
shots: Perfect geometrical symmetry, immaculate posture, stoic expression.
Slight head tilt, hand running fingers through hair, breaking formal symmetry.
Dynamic movement, asymmetric stance, disheveled posture, energetic tension.
Kinetic liberation—body in motion, wild expression, loose limbs, uninhibited freedom.

arcs.title: Grief to Resilience
shots: Seated, head resting heavy in hands, collapsed chest, profound sorrow.
Hands drop, chin stays down, eyes look forward with quiet endurance.
Standing up, pushing shoulders back, deep breath, grounded stance.
Elongated spine, chin lifted past horizontal axis, defiant unwavering smile of survival.

arcs.title: Restraint to Liberation
shots: Isometric tension—clenched fists, tight body frame, frozen stillness.
Micro-release—fists uncurling, jaw loosening, breath exhaling.
Sweeping arm motion starting to extend outward from body.
Explosive dynamic movement—extended limbs, mid-air energy, hair tossed, free spirit.

arcs.title: Solitude to Belonging
shots: Hugging knees tight to chest, inward gaze, physically self-contained.
Unfolding legs, placing feet flat, looking up off-frame.
Reaching one hand outward toward the camera lens.
Open posture, warm welcoming arms, radiant engaging smile.

arcs.title: Skepticism to Delight
shots: One eyebrow raised, lips pursed, arms folded tightly, head cocked back.
Posture softens, subtle smirk forming at corner of mouth.
Soft genuine laughter breaking through, hands coming together.
Full beam joy, head tossed back in candid laughter, open relaxed body language.

arcs.title: Stoicism to Vulnerability
shots: Unreadable stone face, rigid spine, hands held stiffly at side.
Eyes soften, posture relaxes, breath released through open lips.
Hand gently touches heart/chest, slight head tilt, tender gaze.
Soft intimate stance, quiet raw honesty in eyes, completely exposed emotion.

arcs.title: Suspicion to Trust
shots: Angled away, narrow eyes squinting at camera, hands behind back.
Turning to face camera, eyes widening, hands coming to front.
Open palms displayed softly toward camera, neutral stance.
Warm, inviting body posture, gentle smile, full eye-level trust.

arcs.title: Melancholy to Wonder
shots: Slumped posture, sullen downcast expression, limp hands.
Head turns toward a light source, eyes wide open in recognition.
Standing up straight, chest lifting, mouth parted slightly in discovery.
Expansive posture, eyes shining with awe, radiant inspired expression.

arcs.title: Stillness to Kinetic Flow
shots: Perfectly static, rigid pose, feet aligned, arms flat to body.
Subtle wrist and neck rotation, shifting weight to toes.
Torso twisting, arms fluidly sweeping through the air.
Full kinetic spin/twirl, skirt flaring out, dynamic fluid energy.

arcs.title: Compression to Expansion
shots: Crouched low, tucked into a ball, compact footprint.
Rising to knees, extending spine upward, opening arms slightly.
Standing full height, feet hip-width apart, elbows bent wide.
Arms fully outstretched, wide stance, taking up maximum frame space.

arcs.title: Tension to Fluidity
shots: Sharp jagged angles in arms and legs, high muscle tension.
Softening elbow and knee joints, relaxing jawline.
S-curve spine posture, fluid wave-like arm placement.
Effortless high-fashion sway, elegant fluid movement.

arcs.title: Grounded to Airborne
shots: Heavy low crouch, palms pressing into floor/stool.
Pushing up onto balls of feet, reaching hands skyward.
Full vertical extension on tiptoes, stretched torso.
Mid-jump or dynamic leap frame, weightless floating pose.

arcs.title: Mechanical to Organic
shots: Sharp 90° angles in limbs, robotic blank stare, stiff neck.
Asymmetrical limb adjustments, blinking eyes, subtle head tilt.
Natural curve in spine, hands relaxing into soft gesture.
Warm, organic human posture, soft curves, genuine expression.

arcs.title: Rhythm Building
shots: Tapping toe, hand resting on thigh, listening attitude.
Shoulders grooving, head nodding, playful smirk.
Mid-snap or hip sway, energetic movement taking over.
Full dance movement, expressive dynamic pose, high energy.

arcs.title: Heavy Gravity to Zero-G
shots: Shoulders pulled down by gravity, heavy steps, downward energy.
Straightening spine, lifting chin, defying weight.
Arms floating up to shoulder height effortlessly.
Arching back slightly, head back, light ethereal floating stance.

arcs.title: Anchor to Departure
shots: Both feet locked firmly together, static central placement.
One foot stepping out of line, body pivoting sideways.
Mid-stride walking motion towards the edge of frame.
Turning back over shoulder during stride, dynamic departing pose.

arcs.title: Minimalist to Dramatic
shots: Clean neutral portrait stance, hands at side, neutral face.
Creating sharp geometric frame with arms around face.
High fashion arch in back, dramatic shoulder drop.
Extreme editorial pose—exaggerated proportions, high drama.

arcs.title: Commercial to Vogue
shots: Standard catalog smile, hand on hip, straight posture.
Smile drops to high-fashion deadpan gaze, weight shifts.
Angular elbow placement, chin jutting forward, elongated neck.
Iconic couture stance—dramatic neck extension, intense gaze.

arcs.title: The Garment Reveal
shots: Skirt held compressed against legs by hands.
Hands gripping skirt edges, pulling fabric slightly outward.
Lifting skirt tiers to show volume and print details.
Full skirt twirl/flare, fabric catching air, emphasizing colors and movement.

arcs.title: Silhouette to Texture
shots: Strong outer contour pose, limbs creating clear silhouettes.
Hands touching garment waistline, pulling focus to batik pattern.
Bringing one hand up to adjust neckline, highlighting top texture.
Posed specifically to showcase ruffle layers and full outfit assembly.

arcs.title: Classical to Contemporary
shots: Contrapposto classical marble sculpture pose, gentle curves.
Posing becomes sharper, modern geometric arm placement.
Asymmetric, edgy street-style posture, relaxed shoulders.
Ultra-modern street-fashion stance—attitude, sharp angles, confidence.

arcs.title: Architectural Structure
shots: Focus on vertical lines—tall straight posture, arms pinned down.
Focus on triangle angles—elbows flared out to sides.
Focus on volume—skirt held out wide, chest expanded.
Complex 3D sculptural form combining angles, curves, and volume.

arcs.title: Runway Entrance
shots: Paused at back of frame, waiting stance, looking down.
Stepping forward with purpose, rhythmic stride.
Reaching front of stage, stopping on powerful pivot foot.
Final runway pose—signature hip pop, commanding camera stare.

arcs.title: The Fitting Arc
shots: Pulling at clothes awkwardly, adjusting skirt waistband.
Smoothing down fabric tiers, checking alignment.
Checking fit in reflection, standing taller.
Rocking the outfit with effortless style, flawless presentation.

arcs.title: The Audition Arc
shots: Clutching hands, nervous smile, timid posture.
Taking a deep breath, stepping onto mark, settling nerves.
Delivering character beat—engaging expression, clear body language.
Post-audition triumph—relaxing, broad genuine smile, charismatic charm.

arcs.title: The Royal Ascension
shots: Head bowed, humble posture, hands held respectfully low.
Spine straightening, head lifting as if accepting a crown.
Shoulders expanding, majestic upright regal alignment.
Imperial poise—regal posture, calm supreme gaze, ultimate dignity.

arcs.title: The Detective's Realization
shots: Hand on chin, furrowed brow, looking down thoughtfully.
Eyes widening, hand dropping, sudden clarity.
Pointing finger slightly, head snapping to camera.
Triumphant knowing smile, confident forward stance, mystery solved.

arcs.title: Daydream to Action
arcs.summary: Lost in Thought → On a Mission
shots: Distant vacant stare, soft slumped body, dreaming off-camera.
Eyes focusing, head turning sharply to face front.
Muscles engaging, stepping out of relaxed posture.
Purposeful forward momentum, determined face, ready for action.

arcs.title: The Athlete's Warmup
shots: Stretching shoulders, rolling neck, cold muscles.
Shaking out hands and limbs, bouncing on balls of feet.
Deep athletic ready stance, hands on knees, hyper-focused eyes.
Explosive victory flex—power stance, triumphant energy.

arcs.title: The Metamorphosis
shots: Arms wrapped tight around body, knees together, curled inward.
Arms slowly uncurling from torso, head lifting.
Elbows reaching outward, torso expanding, spine lengthening.
Full bloom—arms spread wide like wings, radiant beauty, open heart.

arcs.title: The Warrior's Calm
shots: Clenched jaw, aggressive posture, intense glare.
Closing eyes, breathing out anger, relaxing shoulders.
Opening eyes with calm clarity, stance becoming balanced.
Unshakable inner peace—grounded stance, serene powerful presence.

arcs.title: Shy Flirtation to Bold Charm
shots: Peering through fingers or over shoulder, coy smile, tucked chin.
Lowering hands, biting lower lip playfully, soft eye contact.
Winking or tilting head with confident playful charm.
Bold attractive stance, radiant magnetic smile, pure charisma.

arcs.title: Morning Fatigue to High Energy
shots: Yawning, slouched spine, rubbing eye softly.
Stretching arms overhead, shaking off sluggishness.
Brightening eyes, fresh vibrant smile taking shape.
High-voltage energy—jumping/active pose, beaming smile.

arcs.title: Micro-Expression Showcase
shots: Body locked in place (hands on hips); serious stoic expression.
Identical body pose; subtle eyebrow raise and curious smirk.
Identical body pose; soft gentle smile with warm eyes.
Identical body pose; full open laughter and expressive eyes.

arcs.title: The Secret Keeper
shots: Finger pressed against lips ("shh"), defensive posture.
Finger drops, leaning in toward camera with sly grin.
Hand cupped around side of mouth as if whispering.
Playful knowing laugh, relaxed posture, secret revealed.

arcs.title: Unexpected Surprise to Delight
shots: Wide eyes, open mouth, hands touching cheeks in shock.
Realization setting in, mouth shifting to smile, eyes crinkling.
Hands clapping together in excitement, gasping joyful laugh.
Pure celebration—open arms, beaming joy, dynamic stance.

arcs.title: The High-Contrast Juxtaposition
shots: Extreme vulnerability—curled up tight, eyes closed.
Sudden snap to high corporate formality—stiff erect spine.
Sudden snap to wild kinetic motion—mid-stride dynamic movement.
Final snap to ultimate relaxed power—casual lean, radiant smile.
